titles.notes: Source of title: relationship of image to cat. no. 265.
titles.title: Untitled (Old Tree)

description: A loosely painted tree with bright red branches twists and spreads across the composition. The tree is covered with yellow and green foliage denoted by loose brushstrokes. The semiabstract scene is set against a dark blue background.
title: Untitled (Old Tree)
